strongs.def: to bind fast, i.e. close (the eyes); intransitively, to be (causatively, make) powerful or numerous; to crunch the bones
strongs.kjv: break the bones, close, be great, be increased, be (wax) mighty(-ier), be more, shut, be(-come, make) strong(-er)
strongs.from: a primitive root; also denominatively (from H6106 (עֶצֶם))
